headline: Ward 27 leads Chicago on new housing investment and trails it on pollution-site proximity.
summary:
Near West Side, West Town, Humboldt Park, and Near North Side make up Ward 27. Its composite score of 50.61 puts it 15th out of 50, in the upper half of the city. New construction is most of the story here. The ward leads the city in reported investment in new residential permits, at $279.7 million, in the number of new permits issued, 44, and in the estimated new housing units those permits will bring, 633. It also collected more TIF increment revenue than anywhere else in Chicago, $256.4 million, and every graffiti removal request logged here closed in zero days, also a citywide best. Arts and culture ranks second, with 13 mapped venues and spaces.

The weaknesses sit somewhere else. Ward 27 posts the worst pollution-site proximity score in the city, a measure of how close residents live to Superfund sites, brownfields, and other contaminated land under state remediation. It also sits low on both traffic injuries and pedestrian and cyclist crashes, each 49th of 50. Licensed music and dance venues are scarce too, last among the 48 wards with usable data.
reading_the_rankings: The attendance figure that puts the ward at 50th of 50, 41 percent, comes from a count that folds together more than one term in office. The measure's own description explains that whenever representation changed mid-session, the source combines whoever held the seat across the full year into one ward number, so the 41 percent reflects the ward's full-year record rather than any single person's time in the chair. The three first-place construction rankings, spanning investment dollars, permit count, and estimated new units, read as commanding, but the central half of the ranking is only about four to five points wide on those measures, so most wards in Chicago sit close together and Ward 27's lead is a narrow margin over a crowded field rather than a wide one. The TIF increment ranking, also first in the city at $256.4 million, rests on the softest evidence of the group. The team behind that figure rates it low confidence by their own admission, and the field behind it runs one ward short of the complete fifty.

news.headline: Man Killed, Another Wounded By 5 Gunmen Outside River North Hotel
news.note: Five masked gunmen opened fire on two men outside a hotel in the 500 block of North State Street, killing a 30-year-old and wounding a 65-year-old.

news.headline: Gilda Basque Tavern Brings Spanish Pintxos To West Town With Crowdfunding Help
news.note: Three chef-partners raised $20,000 through crowdfunding to open a Basque-style pintxos bar on Chicago Avenue in West Town.

news.headline: Streetwear Icon Joe Freshgoods Is Back With Every Now And Then, A Store And Cafe In West Town
news.note: Designer Joe Freshgoods opened a permanent store and cafe, Josephine's, on West Chicago Avenue in West Town.

news.headline: Humboldt Park Neighbor Launches Fundraiser To Provide Swimsuits For Local Kids
news.note: A Humboldt Park resident started a GoFundMe for swimsuits after noticing kids at the pool going without proper swim gear because their families couldn't afford it.
